title: Power Stack Daily Research Refresh
regime: Global duration + energy-inflation collision. US 10Y ~5.19%, US 30Y ~5.48% and Japan 10Y ~3.115% raise the global cost of capital while Brent remains above $100 and distillate inventories are structurally tight.
whatIsNewNow: Global duration stress intensified: US 10Y and 30Y reached multi-decade highs while Japan's 10Y JGB moved above 3.1%.

Refined products moved up the hierarchy. US crude inventories rose, but distillate stocks fell to ~107.4M barrels and remain structurally tight; diesel/product inflation can keep freight, farm costs and Fed pressure elevated independently of crude.
The Trump-Xi meeting extended the trade truce by two months but did not verify durable breakthroughs on tariffs, rare-earth access or advanced-tech/AI restrictions.
Tesla began Semi deliveries to initial customers. This is real commercialization evidence, but pricing, production volume and unit economics remain insufficient for a TSLA score change.

China/HK AI infrastructure is broadening into optical interconnect and silicon-photonics equipment. Ligent Technologies and RoboTechnik are differentiated research names, but new-listing momentum is not an entry signal.
AI/grid remains structurally strong, but 5%+ long rates make funding quality and realizable MW a first-order filter.
whatMattersMostNow: US/Japan long-end yields and the cost of capital
Funded/contracted/energizable AI capacity rather than announced MW
Whether high-quality watchlist names offer price asymmetry instead of theme-only exposure

powerGrid.conclusion: Physical bottlenecks remain among the strongest secular themes. PWR/ETN/VRT/GEV quality remains high, but 5%+ yields demand better entry asymmetry; do not chase.

aiDataCentres.conclusion: Demand remains strong, but announced MW is downgraded unless it clears customer contract, sponsor/financing, grid/self-supply, permits/water, equipment and FCF tests.

nuclear.conclusion: Baseload/data-centre power demand supports the buildout, but near-term priority falls behind rates, refined products and grid bottlenecks.

uraniumFuel.conclusion: CCJ remains preferred quality exposure; falling price improves valuation but tape stabilization is required before increasing priority.

oilGas.conclusion: XOM remains the best-quality current holding exposure. HIBISCS is higher beta. LNG retains differentiated structural value; avoid treating a crude spike as permanent scarcity.

metals.conclusion: FCX stays active around disciplined levels. Copper/electrical demand has grid support, while rare-earth/yttrium security remains strategically important.

roboticsAutomation.conclusion: Fixed/warehouse automation and cobots remain commercially ahead of general-purpose humanoids. New HK listings are research-only until economics/pricing prove out.

agricultureFertilizerFood.conclusion: CTVA and NTR remain the cleaner active price research. CF needs a base. BG/VMI move to background; AGCO remains second-stage until farm economics improve.

preciousMetals.conclusion: Gold's structural fiscal/geopolitical case survives, but high yields and firm USD dominate tactically. Wait for yields/DXY confirmation.

energyStorageBatteries.conclusion: Grid storage demand is real; generic lithium/cell overcapacity remains a weak-quality expression. TSLA storage is the clearer downstream economics bridge.

softwareCybersecurity.status: AI SECURITY FAVORED / BROAD SAAS DEPRIORITIZED
softwareCybersecurity.conclusion: PANW/CRWD retain differentiated AI-security monetization; CRM/NOW remain background until price/earnings asymmetry improves.

hongKongChina.status: SELECTIVE / EVENT RISK REDUCED, DOMESTIC DEMAND NOT REPAIRED
hongKongChina.conclusion: The trade truce removes one cliff but not structural domestic-demand or strategic-supply issues. Research Ligent optical interconnect and RoboTechnik automation without chasing listing momentum.

malaysia.conclusion: YTLPOWR structural power thesis remains strongest but financing/FCF hurdle rises. MISC/HIBISCS are holds; DAYANG remains no-new-money until operating conversion improves.
